entries.01010f8c7ee39d85: It completed the final year of its Medium-Term Management Plan covering April 2023 to March 2026, and entered the first year of the Medium-Term Management Plan 2028 (April 2026 to March 2029), announced in April 2026. Under a newly formulated growth strategy, the company states that it will work toward achieving its targets three years ahead.
entries.073ada0c13904501: This business is conducted by overseas subsidiaries, which procure and sell semiconductors and electronic components mainly from the Samsung Group overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥473,783 million (up 61.0% year on year), accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. Sales of high-pixel CIS for smartphones declined, while memory products for servers and storage and for automotive applications increased.
entries.091c54e438550415: This business is conducted by the company, which procures semiconductors and electronic components mainly from the Samsung Group in Japan and sells them to domestic customers. In Japan, it has sales offices close to its customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥159,885 million (up 25.6% year on year), with sales increasing in automotive-related products and the SiP (System in Package) business.
entries.0df452c2caa165c3: In Japan, the company sells through sales offices located close to customers. Overseas, subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Singapore and the United States sell products in line with customers' shift of production bases overseas. Dividing revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by customer location, China is the largest at ¥452,387 million, and Japan is ¥125,620 million. Revenue from NEW H3C INFORMATION TECHNOLOGIES CO., LTD. was ¥77,877 million, or 11.2% of revenue.
entries.0e9017625c6a681f: It procures semiconductors and electronic components such as memory from the Samsung Group, and generates revenue by selling them to customers: the company sells in Japan, and its subsidiaries sell overseas.
entries.1d107863bc5312fc: Domestic and overseas manufacturers that use semiconductors and electronic components (customer locations: Japan, China, other Asia, and other regions)
entries.242670da9fcf1d41: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,015 million, up 79.2% year on year. The company states that it worked to improve profitability while memory product prices soared.

entries.4328ee2b23635715: This business is conducted by overseas subsidiaries, which procure and sell semiconductors and electronic components mainly from the Samsung Group overseas.
entries.450d6f7ef4371736: Main products handled include memory such as DRAM, NAND FLASH and SSD; system LSI such as SoC, CIS, PMIC and SiP; displays such as liquid crystal panels and organic EL; and others such as LED, MLCC and batteries. In Japan, the company purchases products from the Samsung Group in Japan and sells them; overseas, subsidiaries purchase products from the Samsung Group overseas and sell them.
entries.61dae12e914c50a7: The company group consists of the company, its parent company, 5 subsidiaries, 1 affiliate, and other related companies. The parent company is the general trading company Toyota Tsusho Corporation, which owns 50.2% of the voting rights as of March 31, 2026. Because the company was established by separating out the sales division for Samsung Group semiconductors of the former TOMEN Electronics, it mainly handles products of the Samsung Group. Nexty Electronics Corporation, another related company, mainly handles semiconductor products from foreign manufacturers other than the Samsung Group, and the two companies divide the market between them. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 202.

entries.941b16d731939945: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥633,668 million, up 50.3% year on year. The main reason was an increase in memory products for servers and storage and for automotive use. By product, memory accounted for the bulk at ¥553,203 million (up 59.4%), system LSI ¥63,287 million (up 8.3%), display ¥14,725 million (up 13.8%), and other ¥2,453 million (down 23.7%).
